title: Horizon Implementation Day: Grant Management in Horizon Europe (October 2026)
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: The autumn 2026 edition of the Commission's session on running a Horizon Europe grant: amendments, reporting and payments, and fraud prevention, detection and corrections.
covers: Amendments: the legal basis, the business process and the IT tool
